subject: Commit-lock + add-on uplift: pricing corridor & shortfall protection
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@aureliasys.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Marcus Yeo <marcus.yeo@aureliasys.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal uplift & surge protection — ask and timing

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the roadmap call last week — Aurelia is seeing an acceleration in generative features and we expect a 25–35% increase in inference consumption over the next 9–12 months. Ahead of our renewal next quarter, procurement asked if Redwood can: (1) offer a temporary price protection (price-hold) if we increase committed units to cover the uplift, and (2) include a shortfall-credit mechanism if actual consumption falls below the new commit during the first 6 months.

We also want to add an "add-on" SKU for high-memory inference instances for a limited pilot (roughly 200k tokens/mo to start). Does Redwood have a standard uplift amendment you can share with indicative economics? I attached a short forecast spreadsheet (Aurelia_Renewal_Request_08-01.xlsx).

Ideally we’d get a commercial outline this week so our procurement and finance teams can review before the legal kickoff next week. Can we hop on a 30-min call tomorrow afternoon?

Appreciate it —
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of AI Products, Aurelia Systems
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira@aureliasys.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-01T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal uplift & surge protection — ask and timing

Samira — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. Quick summary of what we can propose (indicative, subject to final legal/finance review):

- Term & commit: 12-month amendment that increases your base committed units by 30% (applies immediately on effective date).
- Price corridor (price-hold): we’ll hold your current blended per-token rate for committed consumption up to the new level for 6 months. If you exceed the commit, overage pricing will apply at the published paygo rate (we can discuss capped overage blocks).
- Shortfall protection: if usage is below the new commit during the first 3 months, we’ll issue a one-time credit equal to 50% of the gap (months 1–3), and a standard 3-month true-up at month 6 to reconcile.
- Add-on SKU (high-memory instances): available as a named add-on SKU priced at a 20% discount to list for the first 90 days, then re-evaluated based on volume. Pilot cap ~200k tokens/mo as requested.
- Billing / PO: we support standard PO + amendment via DocuSign. We can accept Net-60 for the amendment with finance approval (will loop finance).

I’ve attached a draft amendment (internal draft) and can send a cleaned version for legal redlines once you confirm the headline economics. Can we do a 30-min call tomorrow at 3pm PT to walk procurement through the mechanics?

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Aurelia Systems Procurement <procurement@aureliasys.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Marcus Yeo <marcus.yeo@aureliasys.com>, samira@aureliasys.com
Date: 2026-08-02T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal uplift & surge protection — ask and timing

Karthik — thanks for the quick response. A few items from procurement/finance:

- Please send the amendment in trackable DocuSign-friendly format so legal can redline.
- We need to confirm whether shortfall credits are applied as invoice credits or as a one-time rebate applied to the next invoice. Aurelia prefers invoice credits.
- Payment terms: Aurelia is asking for Net-60 for the amended invoices and the ability to aggregate the amendment charges into our quarterly billing cycle. Can Redwood accommodate Net-60 and quarterly aggregation?

Attached is a draft PO we’ll use once economics are locked (Aurelia_PO_draft.pdf). We’ll review your amendment on receipt and share redlines by next Wednesday.

Marcus Yeo
Procurement Manager, Aurelia Systems
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Aurelia Systems Procurement <procurement@aureliasys.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-03T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal uplift & surge protection — ask and timing

Marcus / Samira — copying finance and legal op notes here. Quick answers:

- DocuSign: we will send the amendment as a PDF via DocuSign. Legal redlines are fine; please flag any non-standard terms.
- Credits vs rebate: Redwood’s standard is invoice credits. We will apply the shortfall credit as a credit against the following invoice (we can add a line in the amendment to reflect that).
- Net-60 & aggregation: we can support Net-60 on the amended invoices with a modest revenue holdback clause (internal finance approval needed but likely OK). Quarterly aggregation is acceptable — we’ll note that in billing terms.

I attached Redwood_Amendment_Draft_v3.pdf (minor commercial updates from our side). If you can confirm the PO timeline (you had mentioned early August), we’ll generate the DocuSign envelope with the HubSpot deal link included.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira@aureliasys.com>, Aurelia Systems Procurement <procurement@aureliasys.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-04T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final commercial outline & next steps (DocuSign link)

Samira / Marcus — following up with the confirmed commercial outline: 12-month amendment, +30% committed units, 6-month price-hold up to new commit, shortfall invoice credit (50% gap for months 1–3), add-on SKU at 20% pilot discount (first 90 days), Net-60 and quarterly aggregation accepted (finance holdback clause included).

Next steps:
1) Please review Redwood_Amendment_Draft_v3.pdf and Aurelia_PO_draft.pdf.
2) I’ll send the DocuSign link and HubSpot deal reference — please sign and return by 2026-08-10 so we can schedule the ops handoff (enablement + billing).

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/verify?doc=ABCD1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/2345678

Let me know if you need a quick call; otherwise we’ll await PO and signature. Thanks for moving fast on this.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
